description: This file defines the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportSearchFilterParams class, which extends DateRangeSearchFilterParams to specify search filter parameters for employee leave entitlement usage reports. It includes properties for employee number and report type, with validation for report type values.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Class representing search filter parameters for employee leave entitlement usage reports, including filtering by employee number and report type.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter, or null if not set.

methods.name: getReportType
methods.description: Returns the type of report ('employee' or 'my').

methods.name: setReportType
methods.description: Sets the report type, validating its value against allowed types.
